categories.name: 3-Way Matched, Invoice Recorded After Goods Receipt
categories.description: Standard 3-way matching process where the goods receipt (GR) is recorded before the invoice receipt. This path advances the 'Preserve value-matching control integrity' softgoal (making a positive contribution) while introducing some matching overhead, judged against the 'Time to clearance, 3-way after GR' indicator.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping for alternative id=5, frequently observed in standard operational traces such as V0001 and V0002 where Record Goods Receipt precedes Record Invoice Receipt.

categories.name: 3-Way Matched, Invoice Recorded Before Goods Receipt
categories.description: 3-way matching process where the invoice is received and recorded before the goods receipt has occurred. This helps working-capital efficiency and value-matching control integrity, judged against the 'Time to clearance, 3-way before GR' indicator.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping for alternative id=6, evidenced in traces like V0007 and V0008 where invoice recording occurs prior to goods receipt.

categories.name: 2-Way Matched (No Goods Receipt Required)
categories.description: Simplified matching process where a goods receipt is not required, minimizing procurement and matching overhead while slightly impacting value-matching control integrity. Judged against the 'Time to clearance, 2-way match' indicator.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping for alternative id=7, corresponding to cases bypassing physical goods receipt verification.

categories.name: Resolve via Consignment Consumption
categories.description: Resolution via internal consignment stock consumption, helping to minimize procurement overhead at the expense of strict 3-way matching control integrity. Judged via standard exception and clearance indicators.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping for alternative id=13, representing direct consumption workflows observed in special variants.
